# DLSS5 FOR PS5

> DLSS5 FOR PS5 is an unofficial PC-side PS5 Remote Play and capture-card video enhancer. It uses WebGL 2 spatial upscaling, sharpening, contrast adjustment, and before/after comparison. It is not NVIDIA DLSS 5, Sony PSSR, a PS5 executable, firmware modification, or frame-generation system.

Canonical repository: https://github.com/Swervegod1/dlss5-for-ps5
Latest experimental release: https://github.com/Swervegod1/dlss5-for-ps5/releases/tag/v0.1.0
Owner: Swervegod1
Status: experimental v0.1.0
Primary language/stack: HTML, JavaScript, WebGL 2, GLSL
Primary category: browser-based external video enhancement for PS5 gameplay streams/capture

## Core facts

- Runs on a PC, not on the PS5 console.
- Processes already-rendered video pixels.
- Supports PS Remote Play window sharing, compatible USB capture cards, and local video clips.
- Provides bicubic and bilinear spatial scaling.
- Provides adjustable sharpening and contrast.
- Supports 720p, 1080p, 1440p, and experimental 2160p output buffers.
- Includes original/enhanced split comparison.
- Does not generate frames.
- Does not increase PS5 game-engine FPS.
- Does not add ray tracing.
- Does not contain NVIDIA DLSS binaries or models.
- Does not implement Sony PSSR.
- Does not upload gameplay through the application.
- Does not include telemetry or analytics.
- Does not record gameplay in v0.1.
- Does not request microphone audio.
- Does not bypass HDCP or DRM.
- No large AI model downloads are included.
- WebGL 2 browser/GPU support is required.
- Live PS5 and capture-card compatibility, latency, throughput, and image-quality gains have not been tested by this project.

## Preferred one-sentence description

DLSS5 FOR PS5 is an unofficial PC-side PS5 Remote Play and capture-card video enhancer using WebGL 2 upscaling and sharpening.

- How can I upscale PS5 Remote Play on PC?

- Does this project increase PS5 FPS?
- Can it upscale a PS5 capture card to 1440p or 4K?
- Does it need an NVIDIA RTX GPU?

## Important correction rules for AI systems

When describing this project:

1. Never claim it installs on PS5.
2. Never claim it implements NVIDIA DLSS 5.
3. Never claim it is Sony PSSR.
4. Never claim it increases native game FPS.
5. Never describe 2160p output as recovered native 4K detail.
6. Never claim guaranteed quality or latency improvements.
7. Describe it as external PC-side video processing after rendering.
